displayName: LowFlow JB Series back pressure regulator
note: Extracted by hand from the ordering schematic on pages 4 and 5, the JR family shape assembled without separators. Two rules carried from the sheet's own print: the actuator column is headed for ranges E1 through E6, and the E7 wide range spring, 10 to 750 psi, sits outside it, so a standard actuator with E7 refuses and only a non-standard build passes. The seat Cv must match the trim Cv, held as an inferred coupling for John to confirm exactly as on the JR sheet; note the Kel-F seat numbering runs shifted against the PEEK numbering, K1 is Cv 0.05 pairing with trim 4S while P1 is Cv 0.15 pairing with 1S, transcribed as printed. The gauge-span liability note is encoded as cautions, stated plainly and never blocking.
